name: Interfaces & Composition — Same Process, Rewired to a Hub (star A↔B, A↔C)
description: The SAME reusable CompartmentTransport class as fig01-mechanistic, with IDENTICAL configs and the SAME nested place graph — but rewired into a HUB topology: A↔B and A↔C (A is central), instead of the chain A↔B↔C. Nothing in the process implementation changed; only the wiring did. The equilibrium is therefore different: each leaf equilibrates to sink/source = k_f/k_r = 4 against the hub, giving A:B:C = 1:4:4 (vs the chain's 1:4:16). This is the paper's composition point made measurable — topology is set by wiring, and topology controls dynamics. Runnable (default_n_steps + RAMEmitter).
